title: Implement Pexels API client
description: Implement src/lib/images/pexels.ts — a typed client for the Pexels REST API. Used for fetching industry-relevant images when no manual uploads or scraped images are available.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns an array of photo objects with src URL and alt text
Returns photos with appropriate sizes (landscape for hero, square for gallery)
Handles API errors gracefully (returns empty array, does not throw)
Respects 200 req/hr rate limit (no parallel flooding)

steps.details: Use the Pexels REST API directly via fetch (no SDK needed). Base URL: `https://api.pexels.com/v1/search`. Auth header: `Authorization: ${PEXELS_API_KEY}`.
Define interface `PexelsPhoto { url: string; alt: string; photographer: string }`. Test: call `searchPhotos('roofing contractor')` and verify it returns photo objects with valid URLs.

technicalNotes: Pexels requires attribution: store photographer name for display in exported sites.
Use `orientation=landscape` for hero images and `orientation=square` for gallery images.
The Pexels free tier allows 200 requests per hour — sufficient for batch processing with sequential calls.
